t: You are at Kentish Town station, an interchange for London Underground and National Rail services in the London Borough of Camden. It stands at the junction of Kentish Town Road and Leighton Road, in fare zone 2. The station was designed by Leslie Green, an English architect who died in 1908. He is best known for the Underground stations he designed in the first decade of the twentieth century. Their signature is oxblood red faience blocks, pillars, semicircular first-floor windows and patterned tiled interiors in the Modern Style.
